## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement or refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's single Go binary / no frontend build pipeline principles.
- [ ] I have run `go test ./...` and verified that all tests pass.
- [ ] I have updated related documentation in `docs/` and `README.md` / `README.zh-TW.md` if applicable.
- [ ] I have added appropriate comments to explain complex logic.
